d: "Abki Baar... 3000 Paar!" A political slogan turned into a sarcastic take on Delhi's worsening air pollution. The Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) shared a screenshot showing an AQI of 3036 in West Delhi's Nagar Chowkhandi after Diwali. While AQI.in reported extremely high pollution levels, CPCB's official AQI scale is capped at 500. Meanwhile, a political blame game has erupted, with AAP accusing the BJP government of manipulating pollution data and BJP leaders pointing towards stubble burning in Punjab.
